sources: MONDAY NOV 2 2026 PRE-OPEN RUN at 07:15 UTC, which is 02:15 ET, so US cash markets are SHUT, the ISM print is eight hours away and the only live prices on the board are oil, metals and the dollar from the Asian session. HEADLINE: THE OIL TILE BROKE LOWER ON REAL NEWS - BRENT MINUS 3 PERCENT TO ABOUT 110 USD ON IRAN-QATAR TALKS IN DOHA - GOLD IS BOUNCING OFF A ONE-YEAR LOW, EQUITY FUTURES ARE GREEN, AND THE CREDIT QUESTION FROM FRIDAY IS STILL UNANSWERED FOR A THIRD CONSECUTIVE RUN. OIL - THE FIRST GENUINE RISK-PREMIUM UNWIND OF THE WAR. Brent January front month fell to 109.98-110.20 USD, minus 2.9 to 3.0 pct, after a third consecutive day of talks between Iranian negotiators and QATARI MEDIATORS IN DOHA aimed at ending the US-Israeli war on Iran. Iran Foreign Minister Araghchi framed it as continuing consultations and said Tehran stays ready for BOTH defence and diplomacy, so nothing is agreed. WTI 101-102 USD, minus 3 pct. This matters more than the size of the move: for fourteen runs the oil tile has only gone up and only on escalation, and this is the FIRST time the Gulf risk premium has come OUT on a headline. Read the tile with the roll note still attached - the December contract expired Friday at 117.64 USD and January took over at 113.43 USD, so roughly 4 USD of the gap to last week is mechanical. Against a tile of 111.70 on Oct 23 the trend is DOWN, but Brent is still PLUS ABOUT 9.7 PCT ON THE MONTH and sat at a six-month high on Friday. KCM Trade warns rhetoric could reintensify AFTER TUESDAY MIDTERMS and push Brent toward 120 USD, and tanker attacks in the Strait of Hormuz have not stopped. Treat this as a diplomacy option being priced, NOT as the war ending. CREDIT - THIRD RUN BLIND ON THE DECISIVE DAY, AND THIS IS NOW A DATA PROBLEM. FRED BAMLH0A0HYM2 is STILL 3.26 pct for OCT 29, page still stamped Oct 30 09:21 CDT. The OCT 30 print - the day VIX jumped 12.9 pct - has not posted across three runs. Tile carried at 326bp. Against 338bp a week ago the arrow stays DOWN, but the series flipped direction on Thursday (3.38 Oct 23, 3.30 Oct 26, 3.18 Oct 27, 3.14 Oct 28, 3.26 Oct 29), so the DOWN arrow describes last week and NOT Friday. THIS REMAINS THE SINGLE MOST IMPORTANT UNREAD NUMBER ON THE BOARD: wider than 326bp for Oct 30 means Friday was contagion, near 326 means it was an AI-equity reset. It should post during today US session. CURVE - UNCHANGED AT THE HIGH, CONFIRMED FINAL. FRED T10Y2Y Oct 30 at 0.38 (0.37 Oct 29, 0.38 Oct 28, 0.29 Oct 27, 0.32 Oct 26), updated Oct 30 16:03 CDT. Against 0.31 on Oct 23 that is PLUS 7bp, tile UP for a fourth run. Steepening at a new high for the move with no recession signal anywhere else on the board. BREAKEVEN - FADING AT THE MARGIN AND OIL JUST HELPED. FRED T5YIFR Oct 30 at 2.22 pct (2.23 Oct 29, 2.27 Oct 28, 2.25 Oct 27, 2.21 Oct 26), updated Oct 30 16:04 CDT. Against 2.20 on Oct 23 the tile is still PLUS 2bp so it stays UP, but it has now given back 5bp from the Oct 28 high of 2.27, and a 3 pct drop in crude is a direct disinflationary input into the next print. Expect this arrow to turn if oil holds near 110. VOL - CARRIED, CASH MARKETS SHUT. VIX 19.42 on the Oct 30 close, plus 12.91 pct that day, intraday high 22.31, the highest since April. Against 19.45 on Oct 23 the tile is FLAT on the week - a round trip, not a new vol regime. Equity futures point the other way this morning: S&P 500 and Nasdaq 100 futures both about PLUS 0.4 pct, Dow plus 0.3 pct, with Nasdaq 100 futures briefly more than plus 1 pct. Last week closed Nasdaq Composite minus 2 pct, Dow minus 0.85 pct, S&P 500 minus 0.57 pct. METALS - COPPER-GOLD 1.66, AND THE COMPOSITION WARNING NOW CUTS THE OTHER WAY. Spot gold 3,900.90 USD plus 0.7 pct as of 0440 GMT, REBOUNDING after Friday 3.5 pct slump to its lowest since October 2025, a drop driven by forced sales of safe-haven assets and margin calls in the tech rout rather than by macro. Copper 6.4840 USD/lb plus 0.39 pct. The ratio reads 1.6622, so the tile goes 1.67 to 1.66, and against 1.57 a week ago the arrow stays UP. The caveat from the last four runs - that the high was GOLD COLLAPSING rather than copper leading - is now partly unwinding: gold is up, copper is up, and the ratio only eased 1bp. Still do not read this as clean risk appetite. DOLLAR - FLAT FOR A FOURTH RUN AND STILL THE BOARD PUZZLE. DXY spot 102.05, plus 0.09 pct, Dec futures 101.888. Against 101.79-101.81 a week ago that is PLUS ABOUT 0.25, which is FLAT. Traders now price ABOUT A 73 PCT CHANCE OF A DECEMBER FED HIKE per CME FedWatch after three Fed officials argued for more increases on Friday, on top of 3.4 pct Q3 GDP, 3.1 pct core PCE, two hike dissents and a 4.94 pct ten-year. Four runs of that and the dollar has gone nowhere. Either the dollar is wrong or the hike pricing is - this is the cleanest unresolved contradiction on the board. FINANCIAL CONDITIONS - CARRIED, STILL EASY. NFCI minus 0.487 for the week ending OCT 23 (minus 0.494 Oct 16, minus 0.501 Oct 9, minus 0.508 Oct 2), updated Oct 28. Tile minus 0.49, FLAT, and still loosening slowly. Next update WEDNESDAY NOV 4 and it will be the FIRST NFCI containing any of Friday vol. GLOBAL LIQUIDITY - STILL 1 (STABLE), NO NEW PRINT. FRED WALCL unchanged at 6,745,635 million USD for OCT 28 (6,753,604 Oct 21, 6,755,639 Oct 14, 6,747,560 Oct 7), updated Oct 29 15:32 CDT. Minus 7,969 million on the week, a mild drain, far from a regime change; no change at the ECB, PBOC or BOJ. Tile 1. Next WALCL THURSDAY NOV 5. LABOUR - CARRIED, NO NEW PRINT, NO CRACK. Initial claims 194k for the week ending OCT 24 (195k Oct 17, 200k Oct 10, 198k Oct 3, 199k Sep 26), updated Oct 29 07:34 CDT. Against 195k a week ago, FLAT. Next print THURSDAY NOV 5 and the payrolls report lands this week. MACRO TILES - ALL CARRIED. ISM Manufacturing 54.5 September - the OCTOBER PRINT IS DUE TODAY AT 10:00 ET, i.e. AFTER THIS RUN, and it is the first hard macro test of the week. Consumer sentiment 48.0 UMich October final, a five-month low. Building permits 1,398k SAAR September revised. Sahm Rule 0.00 September, confirmed, trigger plus 0.50, next Nov 6. LEI y/y plus 1.2 pct carried and STILL LOW PRECISION - the Oct 22 Conference Board release has the index unchanged at 99.6 and publishes no y/y figure. All FLAT. BLIND SPOTS - MOVE IS NOW EIGHTEEN RUNS STALE AND IT IS STILL THE EXPENSIVE GAP. MOVE CARRIED at 103.31 for OCT 23 for an EIGHTEENTH consecutive run: the Investing.com quote page itself shows Closed 23/10 at 103.31 minus 3.30 pct, the historical table still ends at Oct 23 (106.84 Oct 22, 95.94 Oct 21, 101.70 Oct 20, 101.30 Oct 19, 101.10 Oct 16), MacroMicro refused to serve again and CNBC quote pages failed this run. TREAT MOVE AS BLIND, NOT AS CALM - it is held FLAT by default across the exact window where equity vol jumped 13 pct, the ten-year sits at 4.94 pct and a December hike is 73 pct priced. Rate vol is the one reading that separates an equity event from a rates event, and we still cannot see it. The 3M SOFR-OIS spread is a STANDING ASSUMPTION at 0bp and the EUR/USD 3M cross-currency basis a STANDING ASSUMPTION at minus 10bp, not measurements. FRED series HTML pages served fine this run; multi-series and CSV endpoints were not attempted. Scorecard: two assumed tiles, one judgement tile (global liquidity), one stale tile (MOVE), one low-precision carry (LEI), one blind-on-the-key-day carry (HY) out of eighteen. CALENDAR - THE BUSIEST WEEK IN A MONTH, STARTING IN HOURS: ISM MANUFACTURING TODAY MONDAY NOV 2 10:00 ET. US MIDTERMS TUESDAY NOV 3, with a reported post-midterm US decision on resuming strikes on Iran. NFCI WEDNESDAY NOV 4. WALCL and jobless claims THURSDAY NOV 5. Sahm and the jobs report FRIDAY NOV 6. Earnings from Apple, Palantir, AMD, Pfizer and McDonalds this week, plus several Fed speakers. October CPI mid-November. Next FOMC December. INFRASTRUCTURE: git HEALTHY before this run (HEAD ec62fe1, the Nov 1 commit) and THE LOCK-FILE PILE IS GONE - zero .git lock files this run, so the slow-burning breakage flagged for the last several runs has cleared itself and no delete permission is needed for it. Untracked junk still in the repo root: _wtest, __pycache__/ and outputs/. STILL OPEN - SECURITY, EIGHTEENTH RUN: the origin remote is an HTTPS URL with a GitHub personal access token in PLAIN TEXT in .git/config; fine-grained and repo-scoped, but it should be rotated and replaced with an SSH remote. This is now the only unresolved infrastructure item. PICTURE: THE MACRO BOARD IS UNCHANGED AND STILL REFLATIONARY - growth hot, labour fine at 194k claims, conditions easy at minus 0.49, liquidity stable, curve steepening at a new high, nothing recessionary visible anywhere - while the PRICE side is now moving in OPPOSITE directions in its two cracked places. The AI complex is still broken and unresolved, but the GULF PREMIUM STARTED COMING OUT for the first time: oil minus 3 pct, gold bouncing, breakeven fading, equity futures green. That combination - cheaper energy plus a 73 pct December hike probability - is disinflationary at the margin and should, on paper, finally give the dollar a reason to move. WATCH, IN ORDER OF WEIGHT: whether HY finally posts Oct 30 and whether it is wider than 326bp, which is still the cleanest test of whether Friday was contagion or a tech reset; ISM TODAY after a 3.4 pct GDP print; the MIDTERMS TUESDAY and the reported post-midterm Iran decision, which is the clearest path back to 120 USD Brent; whether the Doha talks produce anything or collapse; NFCI Wednesday as the first conditions read containing Friday; payrolls Friday; getting a live MOVE print; whether the dollar finally responds; rotating the embedded PAT.
